title_zh: 澄清虚构战争短剧的时间顺序并分段排练

scenario.label_zh: 排练虚构战争短剧的被囚场景
scenario.goal_zh: 区分入侵消息与后续被囚场景的时间，约定先排练信使段落再换景

context_zh: 学校剧团排练虚构历史短剧，讨论的是故事中的角色和场景。
author: author-phase08-a

sentences.speaker: Oscar
sentences.text: Does the army invade the city in this scene, or has that already happened?

sentences.speaker: Ivy
sentences.text: The invasion begins offstage. Your messenger brings the news to the council.

sentences.speaker: Oscar
sentences.text: Then why does my next line say the mayor is in jail? That seems too soon.

sentences.speaker: Ivy
sentences.text: That line belongs to the following scene, which is set a week later. You've turned two pages.

sentences.speaker: Oscar
sentences.text: Ah, I see. So I leave after warning the council, and we change the set before the prison scene.

sentences.speaker: Ivy
sentences.text: Exactly. Let's rehearse the message first, stop at your exit, and then work on the scene change.

sentences.speaker: Oscar
sentences.text: Ready. I'll start from the knock at the door.
